shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && ls && cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 -i "table" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination 2>&1 | head -60; sed -n 150,400p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | rg -n -i -C3 "table|button|icon|theme" | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/Table build/esm/components/Table/hoc build/esm/components/Pagination 2>&1; for f in build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

rg -n "meta|sort" build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js | head -40; rg -n "Table|Pagination" build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/hoc/index.d.ts; rg -n -i "page.*1|first page|onUpdate" build/esm/components/Pagination/README.md 2>/dev/null | head; ls build/esm/components/Pagination; rg -n "meta|selectionColumn|selectedIds" build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js | head -20

rg -n "hoc|withTable" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts; sed -n 40,60p build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js; rg -n "page" build/esm/components/Pagination/utils.js | head -15; rg -n "Pagination|Table|Label|Text|Flex|Card" README.md | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && rg -n "theme\?|size\?|type LabelProps|interface LabelProps" Label/Label.d.ts; rg -n "ButtonView =|view\?|size\?" Button/Button.d.ts | head; rg -n "variant" Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|'body-1'" -l . | head -3
sed -n 1,10p Button/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A12 Button/*.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 95,118p Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/DataTable.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import type {LabelProps, PaginationProps, TableColumnConfig, TableSortState} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';",
"import type {\n    LabelProps,\n    PaginationProps,\n    TableColumnConfig,\n    TableSortState,\n    WithTableSortingProps,\n} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';")
s=s.replace("withTableSelection<Employee>(withTableSorting<Employee>(Table))","withTableSelection<Employee, WithTableSortingProps>(withTableSorting<Employee>(Table))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
